newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda licenses investments worth $3 billion.
newsitem.headline: Uganda licenses investments worth $3 billion.

text.p: The Uganda Investment Authority (UIA) said on Friday that it had licensed 2,009 projects in the July 1991 to October 1996 period worth a total $3.249 billion.
A UIA report said that the projects would generate 136,926 jobs but did not say when the jobs would be available.

The UIA report for September-October 1996 said a total of 72 projects were licensed in that period with a potential to create 5,885 jobs. It added that it had received 63 formal investment applications in the period under review.
The report did not give comparative figures for September-October 1995.
Projects licensed included leisure resorts and hotels, transport, manufacturing, mining, construction and grain milling, according to UIA documents.
